title: Apify Free Plan: $5 Credits = ~1,250 Maps Places
snippet:
Yes. Apify's Free plan is permanent, requires **no credit card**, and grants **$5 in prepaid platform usage every billing cycle** at a [**$0.20/CU compute rate**](https://apify.com/pricing?fpr=use-apify). You get full access to the [Apify Store](https://apify.com/store?fpr=use-apify), up to **16 GB RAM per Actor**, 5 datacenter proxy IPs, and residential proxy at $8/GB. Concurrent-run limits are disputed between Apify's own pages — see below. Credits do not roll over, and the platform blocks new runs when the $5 budget is exhausted.

| Resource | Free plan limit |
|---|---|
| Monthly prepaid usage | **$5** (does not roll over) |
| CU rate | $0.20/CU ([apify.com/pricing](https://apify.com/pricing?fpr=use-apify)) |
| Max Actor RAM | **16 GB** per run ([platform limits](https://docs.apify.com/platform/limits?fpr=use-apify)) |
| Max combined memory | 16 GB across all running jobs |
| Max concurrent runs | 5–25 (disputed, see note below) |
| Datacenter proxy | 5 IPs included |
| Residential proxy | $8/GB, in-platform only on Free |
| SERP proxy | $2.50 per 1,000 SERPs |
| Storage retention | Your **10 most recent runs kept for 4 months**; named storages kept indefinitely ([storage docs](https://docs.apify.com/platform/storage/usage?fpr=use-apify)) |
| Tasks & schedules | Included |
| Rented Actors | Trial only |
| Support | Community (Discord, Help Center) |
Free-plan concurrency: Apify's own pages disagree
[apify.com/pricing](https://apify.com/pricing?fpr=use-apify) lists Free at **5 concurrent runs**. [docs.apify.com/platform/limits](https://docs.apify.com/platform/limits?fpr=use-apify) lists Free at **25**, in its "Maximum number of concurrent Actor runs per user" table. Both checked 2026-09-09; the docs page carries no last-updated date. The two pages agree on every paid tier — Starter 32, Scale 128, Business 256. **Assume 5** when you plan a schedule, and confirm the real ceiling on your account's Limits page before you rely on it.

**The trap most free-plan guides miss.** Store Actors publish a headline price like "from $2 / 1,000 results". That "from" is the **best-tier** rate, unlocked by a paid subscription. The free plan sits in the **FREE pricing tier and gets no discount**, so you typically pay two to three times the headline number. This is separate from platform compute and is billed as [pay-per-event or pay-per-result](https://use-apify.com/docs/what-is-apify/apify-pay-per-event) on top of it. title: Apify Pricing [2026]: What You Actually Pay
snippet:
Apify pricing starts with a free plan that includes $5 of usage every month. Paid plans start at $19 a month for Starter and $199 for Scale, and each one gives you the same amount back as credit to spend on the platform.

Every paid Apify plan is a monthly fee that comes back as the same amount of **prepaid usage**: credit you spend on running scrapers, proxies, storage and data transfer. The free plan costs nothing and includes $5 of it. Higher plans also pay less per unit.

| Plan | Monthly price | Prepaid usage per month | Price per compute unit | Store discount tier | Support |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Free | $0 | $5 | $0.20 | Free | Community |
| Starter | $19 | $19 | $0.20 | Bronze | Chat |
| Scale | $199 | $199 | $0.16 | Silver | Priority chat |
| Business | $999 | $999 | $0.13 | Gold | Account manager |
Enterprise plans are priced individually, and Enterprise customers get two extra Store discount tiers, Platinum and Diamond.
Prices are as of November 20, 2026, from the [Apify pricing page](https://apify.com/pricing?fpr=wtalrp&utm_source=crawlworks.io). The free plan doesn’t need a credit card. Annual billing takes 10% off the subscription price. You can switch to annual at any time, but going back to monthly means contacting Apify support, and you won’t get a refund for the rest of the year.

The free plan gives you $5 of prepaid usage every month. At $0.20 per compute unit, that’s 25 CUs to spend.
In practice, 25 CUs goes a reasonable distance. A standard scraping job with 1 GB of memory running for 10 minutes consumes roughly 0.17 CU. You could run that same job around 150 times within your monthly free credits if you’re only charged for platform usage.

The Starter plan gives you $19 of prepaid usage each month, the same as the subscription fee. You also get Bronze-tier prices on participating Actors in the Apify Store.
You can have 32 Actor runs going at once and give a single run up to 32,768 MB of memory. That per-run cap is separate from your account’s total: all your runs together can use up to 64 GB at once, which the pricing page calls “Actor RAM”. If you need more than your $19 in a given month, you can raise your usage limit to a maximum of $100. Support moves up from community to chat.

Each paid plan comes with a discount tier: Bronze on Starter, Silver on Scale, Gold on Business. When an Actor’s developer sets lower prices for higher tiers, users on bigger plans pay less per result or per event.

title: Is Apify free?
snippet:
Yes, Apify offers a free tier that lets you develop actors, run scraping jobs, and explore the platform without paying anything. The free plan includes $5 of monthly platform credits, 10 GB of data transfer, and full access to the Apify Store, API, CLI, and all core platform features.
Here is what you can realistically do with the free tier. The $5 of monthly credits is enough to develop and test actors locally using the Apify CLI, run small to medium scraping jobs (a few thousand pages per month depending on complexity), experiment with different actor templates and frameworks (Cheerio, Playwright, Puppeteer), publish actors to the Apify Store, and access datasets and key-value stores for data management. You also get access to the full Apify API, which means ApifyForge works perfectly with a free account.
There are some limitations to be aware of. The free tier does not include residential proxies, which are essential for scraping websites with strong anti-bot protection like Amazon, LinkedIn, Google, and most social media platforms. If your actors target these sites, you will need a paid plan for proxy access. Data retention on the free tier is 7 days, meaning your datasets and run logs are automatically deleted after a week. Concurrency is also limited, so you cannot run many actors simultaneously.
For many developers, the free tier serves as a development and testing environment. You build and debug your actors on the free plan, then upgrade when you are ready to publish and scale. The Personal plan at $49 per month includes $49 of credits, 30-day data retention, residential proxy access, and higher concurrency limits — which is what most independent developers use for production.
One important note for actor developers: once you start publishing actors with Pay Per Event pricing, users who run your actors generate PPE revenue for you. This means the platform can become self-funding as your actor portfolio grows.

title: scrape.ly/blog/apify-pricing
snippet:
Apify pricing starts with a free plan that includes $5 of platform usage a month, and the paid plans cost $19, $199 or $999 a month (10% less billed yearly). Each plan includes the same amount of prepaid usage as its price, and everything you run draws from it: compute units, proxy traffic, storage and the per-result fees of Store Actors.

| Plan       | Monthly                | Billed yearly | Included usage | Max RAM | Concurrent runs | Store discount | Support         |
| ---------- | ---------------------- | ------------- | -------------- | ------- | --------------- | -------------- | --------------- |
| Free       | $0                     | $0            | $5             | 16 GB   | 5               | None           | Community       |
| Starter    | $19                    | $17/mo        | $19            | 64 GB   | 32              | Bronze         | Chat            |
| Scale      | $199                   | $179/mo       | $199           | 256 GB  | 128             | Silver         | Priority chat   |
| Business   | $999                   | $899/mo       | $999           | 512 GB  | 256             | Gold           | Account manager |
| Enterprise | Custom (contact sales) |               |                |         |                 |                | Dedicated team  |
There is also a Creator plan at $1 a month for developers who build and publish Actors, with a one-time $500 of platform usage for the first six months.

Yes, Apify has a free plan with no credit card. It gives you $5 of platform usage every month at the $0.20 CU rate, up to 16 GB of RAM, 5 concurrent runs and 5 datacenter IPs. Residential proxy costs $8 per GB and, on the free plan, works only inside the Apify platform, not from your own scripts.
Three things limit how far $5 goes:
1. **Store prices are at the Free tier.** Tiered Store Actors charge the free tier the highest price. The Apify Store's Google Maps Scraper by Compass charges $4.00 per 1,000 places on Free, against $3.00 on Bronze.
2. **Credits expire monthly.** What you don't use by the end of the cycle is gone.
3. **There is no overage.** When the $5 is used up, runs are blocked until the next cycle.

### Is the Apify free plan really free?
Yes. It has no time limit and needs no credit card. You get $5 of usage every month, 16 GB of RAM and 5 concurrent runs. When the $5 runs out, runs are blocked until the next cycle, and unused credit does not carry over.

title: Apify Pricing 2026: Plans, Per-Result Costs and an AI Agent | Katteb
snippet:
**TL;DR.** On 13 October 2026 the [Apify pricing page](https://apify.com/pricing) listed four self-serve plans: **Free** at $0 with $5 of monthly usage, **Starter** at $19 a month, **Scale** at $199 and **Business** at $999, each plan’s fee coming back as the same amount of prepaid usage, with anything above it billed as pay as you go. Paying annually takes 10% off: $17, $179 and $899 a month. Compute units cost $0.20 on Free and Starter, $0.16 on Scale and $0.13 on Business.

### Layer 1: the plan is prepaid usage
Each paid plan is a monthly fee that comes back to you as credit of the same size. Starter costs $19 and gives you $19 to spend; Scale costs $199 and gives you $199. If you use more, the overage is added to the next invoice. If you use less, the remainder expires: the FAQ on the pricing page says unused usage credits are not rolled over. The Free plan gives you $5 a month, and when that runs out, your access is blocked until the next monthly cycle. Free has no pay as you go.
| Plan | Monthly billing | Annual billing (per month) | Prepaid usage | Compute unit | Max concurrent runs | Actor RAM |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Free | $0 | $0 | $5 | $0.20 | 5 | 16 GB |
| Starter | $19 | $17 | $19 | $0.20 | 32 | 64 GB |
| Scale | $199 | $179 | $199 | $0.16 | 128 | 256 GB |
| Business | $999 | $899 | $999 | $0.13 | 256 | 512 GB |
| Enterprise | Custom | Custom | Unlimited | Custom | Custom | Custom |

- **Apify’s own Free plan.** $5 a month, no credit card. For a few hundred results a month on a per-result Actor, this is genuinely free. It stops at $5: there is no overage on Free, the account is blocked until the next cycle.

### Is the Apify API free?
The API itself is included in every plan, including Free. You pay for what the Actors you call consume, within the $5 free usage on Free.

Apify pricing is prepaid usage plus pay as you go: $19 on Starter buys $19 of usage, and per-result Actors get cheaper as you move up a plan. For small lists the Free plan is often enough; from roughly 66,000 Google Maps places a month, Scale costs less than Starter.
